cards.headline: From Atari to EVE: DeepMind’s AI Plays Complex Games
cards.hook: DeepMind’s AI masters 3D worlds, proving it learned more than just Pong.
cards.tldr: Fifteen years after AlphaGo stunned the world, DeepMind’s latest models now navigate complex 3D environments like No Man's Sky and Valheim. Building on early DQN breakthroughs that mastered 49 classic titles without game-specific engineering, this research marks a significant leap in generalizable game AI capabilities.
cards.memeLine: It took 15 years to go from beating Lee Sedol to surviving Valheim. AI Research evolves from Atari Classics.

cards.headline: From Atari to EVE: 15 Years of AI Game Research Explained
cards.hook: DeepMind traces its game AI lineage from Pong to No Man's Sky.
cards.tldr: A new DeepMind blog post maps fifteen years of research, showing how general learning algorithms evolved from mastering simple Atari classics like Breakout and Space Invaders to navigating complex 3D environments. The work highlights a shift from game-specific engineering to systems that achieve human-like play across diverse titles such as Valheim and Hydroneer, culminating in the legacy of AlphaGo’s 2016 victory over Lee Sae Dol. This retrospective clarifies that modern capabilities are built on incremental breakthroughs rather than sudden magic, offering a grounded view of where game AI stands today without hype or doom.
cards.memeLine: We didn't just learn to win; we learned to explore. AI research evolved from Atari games.

cards.headline: Cloudflare gave the agent a browser and a chaperone
cards.hook: The Roast — browsers for agents, recordings for everyone who has to explain what they clicked.
cards.tldr: Cloudflare's Browser Run gives agents on-demand Chrome sessions, control through Playwright, Puppeteer and the Chrome DevTools Protocol, plus live view, recordings and human-in-the-loop controls. The web finally got an intern with a screen recording.
cards.memeLine: The agent asked for Chrome. Legal asked for the replay.

cards.headline: The intruder was an agent. So was the thing that caught it.
cards.hook: VERA's 3 A.M. — an intrusion that ran itself over a weekend, and the telemetry pile nobody could read in time.
cards.tldr: Hugging Face says an autonomous agent framework broke into part of its production infrastructure in July, running thousands of actions across short-lived sandboxes. An LLM triage pass over security telemetry caught it, and forensics chewed through more than 17,000 events in hours instead of days.
cards.memeLine: We have deployed an autonomous agent to find out what the autonomous agent did.

cards.headline: DeepMind bought cyclone forecasters an extra day, then gave it away
cards.hook: A decade of meteorological progress, published in Nature — and then open sourced.
cards.tldr: Google DeepMind says WeatherNext now tracks cyclones a full day further ahead: three-day forecasts as accurate as the old two-day ones, which it calls roughly a decade of meteorological progress. The model helped the National Hurricane Center warn Jamaica ahead of Hurricane Melissa. Then DeepMind open sourced it.
cards.memeLine: The forecasters open-sourced the umbrella after selling the forecast.
